recipe.visualDefinition: A medium-shot portrait of a young man with styled auburn hair, wearing a dark overcoat and white shirt, set against a soft, hazy blue and white gradient background. The composition features a prominent geometric logo in the upper right and wide-tracked text at the bottom.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject offset to the left balancing the graphic logo on the right
Soft, diffused lighting on the face contrasting with the sharp geometric lines of the logo
Cool blue background tones contrasting with warm skin tones and hair
Formal attire against an abstract, ethereal studio backdrop
coreInvariants: Soft-focus, airbrushed texture on the background
High-contrast dark clothing against a light-filled center
Geometric diamond-shaped logo container with internal horizontal bands

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is positioned in the left two-thirds of the frame, waist-up, looking slightly off-camera.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The geometric logo in the top right corner acts as the primary graphic anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the subject's face, move to the logo in the top right, and then drop to the text at the bottom edge.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample soft-focus space around the subject's head and to the right side.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Muted blue and white gradient background
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Red and tan within the geometric logo
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation in the background with high value; high contrast in the subject's clothing.

letterConstructionRules: Upper logo text: wide, blocky, geometric sans-serif
Lower logo text: tall, condensed, rounded terminals with uniform stroke weight
Bottom text: high-contrast condensed serif with extreme tracking
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'A' in the logo has a high crossbar
The 'S' and 'E' in the logo are extremely narrow and elongated
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between a heavy, stacked geometric logo and a delicate, widely spaced serif footer.
graphicDevices: Diamond-shaped frame with internal horizontal color blocking
Thin white border around the logo box
Vertical bars/tally marks below the main logo text

preserve: Extreme tracking of the bottom text
The condensed nature of the primary name

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the high-contrast condensed serif look for the bottom text.
Approximate for the wide geometric sans in the top logo bar.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a soft-focus studio portrait of a man with 80s styled hair in a dark trench coat, set against a hazy blue and white airbrushed gradient background. Leave the top right and bottom edge clear for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a diamond-shaped logo in the top right with stacked geometric text. Add a single line of high-contrast condensed serif text at the bottom with very wide letter spacing.

verificationChecks: Is the background soft and hazy?
Is the logo contained within a geometric diamond/rectangle frame?
Is the bottom text extremely tracked out?
Is the color palette restricted to blues, reds, and creams?

adjustableVariables: Tracking width of the footer text
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the artist
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the lighting on the subject matches the soft background glow.
Check that the logo does not obscure the subject's face.
Verify the bottom text is legible despite the wide tracking.
Confirm the graininess level matches late 80s print quality.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a soft-focus studio portrait with a 1980s geometric logo lockup and a high-contrast, wide-tracked serif footer.
